cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: The objective of the course is to give students guidance through a selection of topics of cross-cultural psychlogy such as critical thinking about culture, acquisition of culture, cultural similarities and differences in basic psychological processes, intercultural communication and other topics. Knowledge of these topics might help the students with understanding the relationships of globally connected world and some national and cultural specifics.

cs.label: [section] Požadavky na ukončení:
cs.content: In order to finish the course successfully the student has to: 1) Elaborate a seminar assignment. Students will be provided the details on the first lecture of the course. The assignment instructions are available on Teams, folder L00_Course information. Written assignment is evaluated by the tutor of the course. The assignment will be rewarded by 0-40 points while 20 points are a minimum to get assignment credits ("zápočet"). The relative weight of the assignment evaluation on the overall results is 40 %. Plagiarism, if detected, can be a reason for failing the course and/or starting of a disciplinary procedure. AI tools usage is regulated (see the assignment instructions). Submission: Submit into Coursework submission in UIS. No other ways (e.g. by email) will be accepted. Deadline: 1.5. 2025, 23:59 No assignments after this deadline will be accepted!!! 2) Pass the final exam. The final exam will be composed of multiple-choice and open-ended questions. The student can receive 0-60 points from the exam. The relative weight of the exam evaluation on the overall results is 60 %. 3) Attend the lectures in order to get better chance for passing. The attendance is not obligatory and is not evaluated. The maximum number of points a student can collect is 100. Final marks: 93-100p = A​ 85-92p = B​ 77-84p = C​ 69-76p = D​ 61-68p = E​ 0-60 = F​
